country.evidence_quote: I’ve always wandered. I love bringing lines on a map into three dimensions. I have paddled, cycled, hiked, surfed, and skied many far corners of this incredible planet. My desire to explore might be inherited from my grandparents — immigrants who traveled across Africa and Europe and oceans in between, for a new beginning in Canada. My love of travel and wild places led to a motorcycle trip with my brother from Canada to the southern tip of Argentina in 2014-2015.
